description: German e-invoicing MCP server: ZUGFeRD 2.x, XRechnung 3.x, EN 16931, KoSIT validation, Peppol.
name: io.github.cmendezs/mcp-einvoicing-de

environmentVariables.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO (default), WARNING, or ERROR
environmentVariables.name: EINVOICING_DE_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to opt in to remote KoSIT cloud validation by default across all invoice_validate calls (egresses the full invoice payload). Local Schematron only by default; callers can still opt in per-call with cloud_validate=True.
environmentVariables.name: EINVOICING_DE_KOSIT_ENABLE

environmentVariables.description: URL of a self-hosted KoSIT validation tool REST endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:8080/api/v1/validate), used only when cloud validation is enabled (cloud_validate=True or EINVOICING_DE_KOSIT_ENABLE=1). Defaults to an [Unverified] validator.kosit.de endpoint if unset.
environmentVariables.name: EINVOICING_DE_KOSIT_VALIDATOR_URL
